properties.name: management.health.rabbit.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable RabbitMQ health check.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.address-shuffle-mode
properties.description: Mode used to shuffle configured addresses.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.addresses
properties.description: List of addresses to which the client should connect. When set, the host and port are ignored.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.cache.channel.checkout-timeout
properties.description: Duration to wait to obtain a channel if the cache size has been reached. If 0, always create a new channel.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.cache.channel.size
properties.description: Number of channels to retain in the cache. When "check-timeout" > 0, max channels per connection.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.cache.connection.mode
properties.description: Connection factory cache mode.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.cache.connection.size
properties.description: Number of connections to cache. Only applies when mode is CONNECTION.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.channel-rpc-timeout
properties.description: Continuation timeout for RPC calls in channels. Set it to zero to wait forever.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.connection-timeout
properties.description: Connection timeout. Set it to zero to wait forever.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.dynamic
properties.description: Whether to create an AmqpAdmin bean.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.host
properties.description: RabbitMQ host. Ignored if an address is set.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.direct.acknowledge-mode
properties.description: Acknowledge mode of container.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.direct.auto-startup
properties.description: Whether to start the container automatically on startup.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.direct.consumers-per-queue
properties.description: Number of consumers per queue.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.direct.de-batching-enabled
properties.description: Whether the container should present batched messages as discrete messages or call the listener with the batch.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.direct.default-requeue-rejected
properties.description: Whether rejected deliveries are re-queued by default.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.direct.force-stop
properties.description: Whether the container (when stopped) should stop immediately after processing the current message or stop after processing all pre-fetched messages.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.direct.idle-event-interval
properties.description: How often idle container events should be published.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.direct.missing-queues-fatal
properties.description: Whether to fail if the queues declared by the container are not available on the broker.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.direct.observation-enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable observation.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.direct.prefetch
properties.description: Maximum number of unacknowledged messages that can be outstanding at each consumer.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.direct.retry.enabled
properties.description: Whether publishing retries are enabled.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.direct.retry.initial-interval
properties.description: Duration between the first and second attempt to deliver a message.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.direct.retry.max-interval
properties.description: Maximum duration between attempts.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.direct.retry.max-retries
properties.description: Maximum number of retry attempts to deliver a message.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.direct.retry.multiplier
properties.description: Multiplier to apply to the previous retry interval.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.direct.retry.stateless
properties.description: Whether retries are stateless or stateful.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.simple.acknowledge-mode
properties.description: Acknowledge mode of container.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.simple.auto-startup
properties.description: Whether to start the container automatically on startup.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.simple.batch-size
properties.description: Batch size, expressed as the number of physical messages, to be used by the container.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.simple.concurrency
properties.description: Minimum number of listener invoker threads.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.simple.consumer-batch-enabled
properties.description: Whether the container creates a batch of messages based on the 'receive-timeout' and 'batch-size'. Coerces 'de-batching-enabled' to true to include the contents of a producer created batch in the batch as discrete records.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.simple.de-batching-enabled
properties.description: Whether the container should present batched messages as discrete messages or call the listener with the batch.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.simple.default-requeue-rejected
properties.description: Whether rejected deliveries are re-queued by default.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.simple.force-stop
properties.description: Whether the container (when stopped) should stop immediately after processing the current message or stop after processing all pre-fetched messages.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.simple.idle-event-interval
properties.description: How often idle container events should be published.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.simple.max-concurrency
properties.description: Maximum number of listener invoker threads.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.simple.missing-queues-fatal
properties.description: Whether to fail if the queues declared by the container are not available on the broker and/or whether to stop the container if one or more queues are deleted at runtime.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.simple.observation-enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable observation.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.simple.prefetch
properties.description: Maximum number of unacknowledged messages that can be outstanding at each consumer.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.simple.retry.enabled
properties.description: Whether publishing retries are enabled.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.simple.retry.initial-interval
properties.description: Duration between the first and second attempt to deliver a message.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.simple.retry.max-interval
properties.description: Maximum duration between attempts.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.simple.retry.max-retries
properties.description: Maximum number of retry attempts to deliver a message.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.simple.retry.multiplier
properties.description: Multiplier to apply to the previous retry interval.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.simple.retry.stateless
properties.description: Whether retries are stateless or stateful.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.stream.native-listener
properties.description: Whether the container will support listeners that consume native stream messages instead of Spring AMQP messages.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.stream.observation-enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable observation.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.listener.type
properties.description: Listener container type.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.max-inbound-message-body-size
properties.description: Maximum size of the body of inbound (received) messages.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.password
properties.description: Login to authenticate against the broker.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.port
properties.description: RabbitMQ port. Ignored if an address is set. Default to 5672, or 5671 if SSL is enabled.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.publisher-confirm-type
properties.description: Type of publisher confirms to use.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.publisher-returns
properties.description: Whether to enable publisher returns.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.requested-channel-max
properties.description: Number of channels per connection requested by the client. Use 0 for unlimited.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.requested-heartbeat
properties.description: Requested heartbeat timeout; zero for none. If a duration suffix is not specified, seconds will be used.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.ssl.algorithm
properties.description: SSL algorithm to use. By default, configured by the Rabbit client library.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.ssl.bundle
properties.description: SSL bundle name.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.ssl.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable SSL support. Determined automatically if an address is provided with the protocol (amqp:// vs. amqps://).

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.ssl.key-store
properties.description: Path to the key store that holds the SSL certificate.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.ssl.key-store-algorithm
properties.description: Key store algorithm.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.ssl.key-store-password
properties.description: Password used to access the key store.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.ssl.key-store-type
properties.description: Key store type.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.ssl.trust-store
properties.description: Trust store that holds SSL certificates.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.ssl.trust-store-algorithm
properties.description: Trust store algorithm.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.ssl.trust-store-password
properties.description: Password used to access the trust store.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.ssl.trust-store-type
properties.description: Trust store type.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.ssl.validate-server-certificate
properties.description: Whether to enable server side certificate validation.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.ssl.verify-hostname
properties.description: Whether to enable hostname verification.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.stream.host
properties.description: Host of a RabbitMQ instance with the Stream plugin enabled.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.stream.name
properties.description: Name of the stream.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.stream.password
properties.description: Login password to authenticate to the broker. When not set spring.rabbitmq.password is used.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.stream.port
properties.description: Stream port of a RabbitMQ instance with the Stream plugin enabled.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.stream.ssl.bundle
properties.description: SSL bundle name.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.stream.ssl.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable SSL support. Enabled automatically if "bundle" is provided.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.stream.username
properties.description: Login user to authenticate to the broker. When not set, spring.rabbitmq.username is used.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.stream.virtual-host
properties.description: Virtual host of a RabbitMQ instance with the Stream plugin enabled. When not set, spring.rabbitmq.virtual-host is used.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.template.allowed-list-patterns
properties.description: Simple patterns for allowable packages/classes for deserialization.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.template.default-receive-queue
properties.description: Name of the default queue to receive messages from when none is specified explicitly.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.template.exchange
properties.description: Name of the default exchange to use for send operations.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.template.mandatory
properties.description: Whether to enable mandatory messages.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.template.observation-enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable observation.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.template.receive-timeout
properties.description: Timeout for receive() operations.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.template.reply-timeout
properties.description: Timeout for sendAndReceive() operations.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.template.retry.enabled
properties.description: Whether publishing retries are enabled.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.template.retry.initial-interval
properties.description: Duration between the first and second attempt to deliver a message.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.template.retry.max-interval
properties.description: Maximum duration between attempts.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.template.retry.max-retries
properties.description: Maximum number of retry attempts to deliver a message.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.template.retry.multiplier
properties.description: Multiplier to apply to the previous retry interval.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.template.routing-key
properties.description: Value of a default routing key to use for send operations.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.username
properties.description: Login user to authenticate to the broker.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.virtual-host
properties.description: Virtual host to use when connecting to the broker.
